RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-women panel or selecting a candidate with fewer years of experience does not demonstrate bias. For a practice lead role, firms frequently prioritize client development, commercial acumen, and team leadership over raw technical tenure. 

Accusing the panel of gender bias without concrete evidence will likely harm your professional reputation and alienate industry contacts. Furthermore, a two-week delay for formal feedback is standard in corporate HR processes. 

Instead of raising gender, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how you can strengthen future applications for leadership positions. Focus the inquiry entirely on competencies, client strategy, and group management.
